mapper.insert: /** OrderCommonCsMapper.insertOdCost */ MERGE TB_ECM_OD_COST AS A USING (SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, #{chargeCode} AS CHARGE_CODE) AS B ON (A.OD_JOB_NO = B.OD_JOB_NO AND A.CHARGE_CODE = B.CHARGE_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AP_AMOUNT = #{apAmount} WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT( OD_JOB_NO ,SEQ_NO_ID ,CHARGE_CODE ,CHARGE_NAME ,ACCOUNT_CODE ,ACCOUNT_NAME ,AR_AMOUNT ,AP_AMOUNT ,PAYMENT_GUBN ,CUSTOMER_CODE ,CUSTOMER_NAME ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME )VALUES( #{odJobNo} ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST dim WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) ,#{chargeCode} ,(SELECT CHARGE_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CHARGE WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CHARGE_CODE = #{chargeCode}) ,'' ,'' ,0 ,#{apAmount} ,CASE WHEN LEN(#{paymentGubn}) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0', #{paymentGubn}) ELSE #{paymentGubn} END ,'' ,'' ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) );
mapper.select: /* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectMultiOrderDetail : 멀티오더 상세조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.DELIVERY_NAME ,od.PIECES AS HOUSE_PIECES ,od.GWT ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1_NAME ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,od.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME ,od.UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectMaxCsSeqNo : Order CS History insert */ SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID), 0) FROM TB_ECM_OD_CS_HISTORY WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectBondedTransDetail : 보세운송 상세조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) as CUST_NAME_LV1 ,od.CUST_CODE_LV2 ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV2) as CUST_NAME_LV2 ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS CONSIGNEE_NAME ,bond.BONDED_TRANS_DATE ,bond.BONDED_TRANS_TYPE ,bond.INSPECTION_DROP ,bond.TRANSPORT_DATE ,bond.CARRYOUT_DATE ,bond.CARRYOUT_REMARK ,bond.INPUT_METHOD ,bond.REGISTER_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = bond.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,bond.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,bond.UPDATE_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = bond.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME ,bond.UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_BONDED_TRANS bond ON od.OD_JOB_NO = bond.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectReturnBl : 반품관리 존재여부 */ SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD_RESEND_INFO WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND SEQ_NO_ID = #{seqNoId}

/* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectFileShare : 파일조회 */ SELECT FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID , MAX(FSF.SEQ_NO) AS MAX_SEQ_NO , COUNT(FSF.REFERENCE_NO_ID) AS FILE_SHARE_COUNT FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE FS LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_COM_FILE_SHARE_FILE FSF ON FSF.REFERENCE_NO_ID = FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID WHERE FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID = #{referenceNoId} GROUP BY FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID
/* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectMblInfo : M.B/L 정보조회 */ SELECT OD_JOB_NO ,BOUND ,BOUND_TYPE ,MBL_NO ,CUST_CODE_LV1 FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MBL_NO = #{MBL_NO} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'M' AND BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'
/* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectMaxMultiSeqNo : Order Multi SeqNo */ SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID), 0) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
